name: raft-logic
description: Node.js wrapper around a WASM build of tikv/raft-rs (via wasm-bindgen).

scripts.build:wasm: bash -c 'set -euo pipefail; if [ -d native/raft-wasm ]; then cd native/raft-wasm; elif [ -d packages/raft-wasm ]; then cd packages/raft-wasm; else echo "No raft-wasm crate found (expected native/raft-wasm or packages/raft-wasm)"; exit 1; fi; wasm-pack build --release --target nodejs --out-name raft_wasm --out-dir ../../wasm; cd - >/dev/null; rm -f wasm/package.json wasm/.gitignore; if [ -f wasm/raft_wasm.js ]; then mv wasm/raft_wasm.js wasm/raft_wasm.cjs; fi'
scripts.prepack: bash -c 'set -e; if [ -f wasm/raft_wasm.cjs ] && [ -f wasm/raft_wasm_bg.wasm ]; then echo "Using existing wasm artifacts"; else npm run build:wasm; fi'
